text:
Priya: quick sync — customers are seeing increased hallucination rate on search completions after the rollout. small sample shows bad reranking + cost spike. do we treat this as a P0 hotfix or bundle into next micro-sprint?
Alex: can you drop the failing query examples here? need to see if it's model or prompt drift.
Priya: pasted a couple; looks like a truncation + tokenization mismatch when context > 3k tokens. reproducible locally.
Sam: if it's tokenization/regression from tokenizer tweak, that's a safety/accuracy issue. hotfix. :warning:
Maya: agreed. hurt user trust. but what's the risk to latency/cost if we rollback the tokenizer change?
Priya: rollback reverts a recent performance patch; perf slightly worse (p50 +6ms) but accuracy back. cost delta negligible per our bench.
Alex: order of ops: 1) cut a canary rollback to dedicated pool, 2) run prompt-set regression tests, 3) promote if green.
Sam: +1. need owner for the rollback PR, tests, and customer comms. who volunteers?
Maya: I can own rollback PR and canary. will do test runs with the regression prompt set. estimate 2-3 hrs to land and verify.
Priya: thanks — I'll own customer comms and postmortem. Sam can you create the quick eval harness and mark failing prompts?
Sam: on it. will add assertions for hallucination score + top-1 rerank delta. ETA 90m.
Alex: what's our release window? we should avoid peak traffic 10:00-14:00 PT. propose start at 15:00 PT so we have full-day fallout window.
Maya: 15:00 PT works. I'll schedule canary to 10% traffic for first 15m, 50% for next 15m, then full if green. rollback policy: auto-revert on >1.5x hallucination rate or >2% error rate.
Priya: add monitoring: hallucination_rate, p95 latency, token cost per request. link dashboards when ready.
Sam: added a short dashboard panel and alert rule: `alert if hallucination_rate > baseline*1.5 for 5m`.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: `canary/rollback-tokenizer/1766667777` — will run when PR merged.
Alex: decision: hotfix (must ship today). prioritize over minor UX polish. we can fold UX backlog into next sprint.
Maya: making the PR now, tagging `@eng-oncall` and `@prodops`. will ping when canary starts.
Priya: thanks all. postmortem template in #postmortems once we close. I’ll loop customers who reported. :thumbsup:
Sam: if we need a longer follow-up, propose a mini-spike next week to make tokenizer change backward-compatible instead of full revert.
Alex: agreed, add to roadmap: `tokenizer compatibility follow-up` with owner Sam.
Priya: closing notes: owner assignments — Maya (rollback PR + canary), Sam (eval + dashboard), Priya (comms + postmortem), Alex (priority/approval).
Maya: starting PR now. ETA canary in ~2.5h.
deploy-bot: Canary started: 10% traffic -> monitors active.
Sam: first 15m looks good on latency, hallucination trending down. I'll post charts in 10m.
Priya: great. keep this thread for updates and final sign-off.
Maya: will update when promoted or reverted.
Priya: final sign-off planned after 45m of stable canary.
Maya: promoted to 50% -> observing.
Sam: charts posted — hallucination metric back to baseline. no error spikes.
Maya: promoting to 100%.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete.
Priya: thanks team. logging follow-up action: plan compatibility spike next week; will add to roadmap doc.
